BillHeading.Sponsors: House Judiciary (originally sponsored by Representatives Harmsworth, Hayes, Shea, and Young)
BillHeading.BriefDescription: Concerning information on civil traffic infractions.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to information on civil traffic infractions; and adding a new section to chapter 2.56 RCW.

BillSection.BillSectionHeader: Sec. 1. A new section is added to chapter 2.56 RCW to read as follows:
BillSection.P: The administrative office of the courts may not display any personally identifying information about individual cases filed in courts in this state that involve parking infractions or infractions processed in the same manner as parking infractions under chapter 46.63 RCW on any publicly accessible online case records portal maintained by the administrative office of the courts.
